title: Wizard options regex fix + flow line assignment UI
summary: Two fixes: (1) Wizard AI chat options were showing as raw JSON because regex required mandatory newline after ```options marker - made newline optional in all 4 layers (backend extract, backend strip, frontend strip, frontend display). Also added content field to SSE done event and made code block stripping unconditional. (2) Flow trigger_start node now shows ALL enabled WhatsApp lines with amber warning for lines assigned to other flows, enabling reassignment.

verification_questions.question: Do the regex changes correctly match both with-newline and without-newline options/flowconfig blocks?
Does the LEFT JOIN query correctly return null for unassigned instances and flow info for assigned ones?
Is the flowId comparison in TriggerStartProps safe given flowId comes from useParams as a parsed int?
Does removing the flow_id SQL filter introduce any security concern (cross-tenant data leak)?

review.override_reason: V3 false positive — flowId is parseInt(useParams) = number|undefined, assignedFlowId is number|null. Strict !== comparison handles all 4 cases correctly (verified with truth table). Codex couldn't see context outside diff.
review.cove: V1 PASS, V2 PASS, V3 UNKNOWN (false positive), V4 PASS
